name: Depth Supervision
aliases: Depth Supervision — Depth Prior Supervision, Monocular Depth Supervision
definition: A training technique to improve reconstructed geometry by providing depth priors using off-the-shelf depth estimation models, resulting in better geometry and reduced number of floaters.
summary: Depth Supervision improves geometry by enforcing rendered depth to match external monocular priors, distinguishing itself from methods relying solely on photometric consistency.
